input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Argument.get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so the second element of the tuple is None for an undocumented argument even though format_arguments now feeds every record straight into formatter.write_dl without a fallback.
- failure path: A command declares two arguments and sets help on only one; running it with --help makes write_dl measure and wrap a None description and the help command crashes with a TypeError instead of printing usage.

Reviewer finding
- description: get_help_record now returns self.help unchanged, which is None when an argument has no help text. The removed call-site fallback `or (arg.make_metavar(ctx), "")` no longer covers this, so format_help_text passes a None description to write_dl.
- rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented Argument and one undocumented Argument, so the guard `any(arg.help is not None ...)` passes. Mechanism: the undocumented argument yields (metavar, None), and write_dl calls text wrapping on the None description, which raises an AttributeError or TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for a common mix of documented and undocumented positional arguments, despite the docstring promising an empty description.
critique: The finding describes the same mechanism: get_help_record returns self.help unchanged, so an undocumented argument produces a None description. With the fallback removed, write_dl receives that None and --help crashes when a command mixes documented and undocumented arguments. It names format_help_text rather than format_arguments as the caller, but the path is the same.
